stories.title: Au procès de Rachida Dati pour « corruption », les tentatives de la défense de repousser son interrogatoire

en.title: At Rachida Dati's trial for "corruption", defense attempts to postpone her questioning
en.summary: Rachida Dati, mayor of Paris's 7th arrondissement and former minister, is being tried for allegedly receiving 900,000 euros from Renault-Nissan between 2010 and 2012 while Carlos Ghosn led the company. Ghosn, also facing corruption charges, will be tried in absentia.

stories.title: Aux Etats-Unis, un ancien chef de prison syrien du régime de Bachar Al-Assad condamné à soixante ans de prison pour torture

en.title: In the United States, a former Syrian prison chief from Bashar Al-Assad's regime sentenced to sixty years in prison for torture
en.summary: Samir Othman Al-Sheikh, a former director of Syria's Adra prison, was convicted in the United States of committing human rights atrocities. He arrived in the country in 2020 and was arrested and charged in July 2024 after applying for American citizenship.

stories.title: Budget 2027 : Sébastien Lecornu prépare une "potion d'austérité", "insoutenable" et "irresponsable", estime le socialiste Arthur Delaporte

en.title: Budget 2027: Sébastien Lecornu prepares an 'austerity potion', 'unsustainable' and 'irresponsible', says socialist Arthur Delaporte
en.summary: Socialist parliamentary spokesperson Arthur Delaporte criticized the government's 2027 budget approach as austerity measures imposed on French citizens, arguing it represents the wrong policy direction.

stories.title: Budget 2027 : le déficit dérape, Sébastien Lecornu repousse d’un an le redressement des comptes

en.title: 2027 Budget: deficit spirals, Sébastien Lecornu delays fiscal correction by one year
en.summary: The French government acknowledged the deficit is expected to reach 5.4% of GDP in 2026, exceeding the 5% target. The prime minister aims to restore public finances in 2027, though economists remain skeptical about this timeline.

en.title: Budget 2027: Lecornu seeks his billions
en.summary: The Prime Minister outlined plans to achieve a 54 billion euros budgetary adjustment with the ambitious goal of reducing the deficit to 5 percent by 2027.

stories.title: Gel du point d’indice des fonctionnaires : Binet dénonce un «scandale» et promet une «journée noire» le 29 septembre

en.title: Freeze on civil service salary index: Binet denounces a "scandal" and promises a "black day" on September 29
en.summary: A government official announced a freeze on the civil service salary index to save 2 billion euros, prompting a union leader to call the measure a scandal and announce a protest.

stories.title: Gel du point d’indice des fonctionnaires dans le budget 2027 : Sophie Binet dénonce un «scandale» et promet une «journée noire» le 29 septembre

en.title: Freeze on civil service pay index in 2027 budget: Sophie Binet denounces a "scandal" and promises a "black day" on September 29
en.summary: CGT leader Sophie Binet criticized the government's freeze on the civil service pay index, arguing that public employees have lost over 16% of purchasing power since 2017 due to successive index freezes. She announced planned protests.

stories.title: Retraites, gel du point d'indice des fonctionnaires, "carence" pour les étrangers… Les pistes du gouvernement pour réaliser 54 milliards d'euros d'économies sur le budget 2027

en.title: Pensions, freeze on civil service salary index, "shortfall" for foreigners… Government's paths to achieve 54 billion euros in savings for 2027 budget
en.summary: The Prime Minister outlined budget measures aimed at reducing deficits and achieving 54 billion euros in savings for the 2027 state budget through various policy adjustments.

stories.title: Gel du point d’indice des fonctionnaires, contribution des retraités… Ce qu’il faut retenir de l’interview de Sébastien Lecornu sur le budget dans «le Figaro»

en.title: Freeze on civil service salary index, retirees' contribution… What to remember from Sébastien Lecornu's interview on the budget in "Le Figaro"
en.summary: The Prime Minister announced an increased budgetary effort of 54 billion euros instead of 30 billion for 2027, with specific savings measures affecting public sector pay and pensions.

stories.title: Jeunes, retraités, fonctionnaires : Lecornu va mettre tout le monde à contribution dans le budget 2027

en.title: Young people, retirees, civil servants: Lecornu will require everyone to contribute to the 2027 budget
en.summary: The French government proposes budget savings across housing assistance, sick leave benefits, civil servant salaries, and pension payments to help balance the 2027 budget.

stories.title: Sébastien Lecornu dévoile son budget au Figaro : «Je propose un effort budgétaire d’environ 54 milliards d’euros»

en.title: Sébastien Lecornu reveals his budget to Figaro: "I propose a budget effort of approximately 54 billion euros"
en.summary: The Prime Minister outlines planned budget cuts to be presented to parliament as part of the finance bill, while committing to fiscal stability.

stories.title: Pour le budget 2027, Sébastien Lecornu propose "un effort" d'environ 54 milliards d'euros

en.title: For the 2027 budget, Sébastien Lecornu proposes cost-cutting measures of approximately 54 billion euros
en.summary: The Prime Minister stated that debt servicing is placing increasing strain on the budget equation, proposing roughly 54 billion euros in savings for the 2027 budget.

stories.title: Budget 2027 : de 30 à 54 milliards d’euros d'effort budgétaire, le grand écart de Lecornu

en.title: 2027 budget: 30 to 54 billion euros in budget effort, Lecornu's balancing act
en.summary: The Prime Minister targets 54 billion euros in budget savings through state spending freeze, contributions from local authorities and social security, and pension adjustments.

stories.title: Ariane 6 : un aléa technique pourrait gripper le calendrier de lancements en 2026

en.title: Ariane 6: technical issue could disrupt launch schedule in 2026
en.summary: Arianespace and ArianeGroup are conducting checks on Ariane 6 equipment, which will require adjustments to the European heavy-lift launcher's mission schedule for 2026.

stories.title: L’IA fait gagner du temps aux salariés, mais la productivité française reste à l’arrêt

en.title: AI saves employees time, but French productivity remains stalled
en.summary: French hourly labor productivity grew only 0.2% annually between 2015 and 2025, down from 1.7% between 1995 and 2005, as digital investment alone proves insufficient without broader technology adoption across firms.

stories.title: Face à l’IA, les habitants des pays riches redoutent déjà une érosion de l’emploi

en.title: Faced with AI, residents of wealthy countries already fear job losses
en.summary: A Pew Research Center survey of over 42,000 people across 37 countries found 46% expect employment to decline in the next two decades, with pessimism strongest in developed economies, among youth, and among women.

stories.title: Sentinel-3 : vingt ans d'observation pour anticiper le climat de demain

en.title: Sentinel-3: twenty years of observation to anticipate tomorrow's climate
en.summary: The European Sentinel 3C satellite was launched into orbit by Vega-C to support climate monitoring and forecasting efforts.
